name: 018-proforma-workflow
statements: CREATE TABLE migration_018_fresh_guard(document_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(document_count=0))STRICT
INSERT INTO migration_018_fresh_guard SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_drafts)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issued_invoices)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proformas)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idempotency_records)

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN('issue_invoice_direct','issue_invoice_from_draft','issue_proforma_direct','issue_proforma_from_draft','issue_invoice_from_proforma','create_draft_invoice_from_proforma','create_correction')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=71 AND substr(fingerprint,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(fingerprint,8)NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),result_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_kind IN('invoice','proforma','draft','correction')),result_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,idempotency_key),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id)REFERENCES issuers(organization_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT)STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER idempotency_records_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON idempotency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idempotency record is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER idempotency_records_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON idempotency_records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'idempotency record is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE proformas_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_draft_id TEXT UNIQUE,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(document_type='proforma'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT,issuer_postal_code TEXT,customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,sealed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sealed IN(0,1)),source_app TEXT,source_kind TEXT,source_id TEXT,notes TEXT CHECK(notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)),issuer_branding TEXT CHECK(issuer_branding IS NULL OR json_valid(issuer_branding)),issuer_legal_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_legal_form IN('srl','pfa')),issuer_trade_registry_number TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_iban TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_bank_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_social_capital TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),issuer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_vat_registered IN(0,1)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,source_draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,document_type,series)REFERENCES document_series(organization_id,document_type,series))STRICT

CREATE TABLE issued_invoices_new(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,draft_id TEXT UNIQUE,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,fiscal_year INTEGER NOT NULL,document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(document_type='invoice'),series TEXT NOT NULL,number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),issue_date TEXT NOT NULL,due_date TEXT,issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='RON'),issuer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_city TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_street TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_county TEXT,issuer_postal_code TEXT,customer_legal_name TEXT NOT NULL,customer_tax_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,customer_country_code TEXT NOT NULL,customer_city TEXT NOT NULL,customer_street TEXT NOT NULL,customer_county TEXT,customer_postal_code TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_total TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,e_factura_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_sent' CHECK(e_factura_status IN('not_sent','pending','sent','accepted','rejected')),customer_party_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(customer_party_type IN('company','individual')),source_proforma_id TEXT UNIQUE,direct_source_proforma_id TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(CASE WHEN draft_id IS NULL THEN source_proforma_id END)STORED,source_app TEXT,source_kind TEXT,source_id TEXT,notes TEXT CHECK(notes IS NULL OR(length(notes) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND trim(notes)=notes)),issuer_branding TEXT CHECK(issuer_branding IS NULL OR json_valid(issuer_branding)),issuer_legal_form TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_legal_form IN('srl','pfa')),issuer_trade_registry_number TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_iban TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_bank_name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer_social_capital TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),issuer_vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issuer_vat_registered IN(0,1)),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),UNIQUE(organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,source_proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,direct_source_proforma_id,id)REFERENCES proforma_invoice_conversions(organization_id,proforma_id,resulting_invoice_id)DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)STRICT
ALTER TABLE proformas_new RENAME TO proformas
ALTER TABLE issued_invoices_new RENAME TO issued_invoices
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_seal_only BEFORE UPDATE OF sealed ON proformas WHEN OLD.sealed=1 OR NEW.sealed!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_content_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id,source_draft_id,organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number,issue_date,due_date,issued_at,currency,issuer_legal_name,issuer_tax_identifier,issuer_country_code,issuer_city,issuer_street,issuer_county,issuer_postal_code,issuer_legal_form,issuer_trade_registry_number,issuer_iban,issuer_bank_name,issuer_social_capital,issuer_vat_registered,issuer_branding,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_postal_code,total_excluding_tax,tax_total,total_including_tax,notes ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proformas are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proformas WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid proforma source');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma source is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proformas_actor_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_id ON proformas BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma actor is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_lines WHEN(SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are sealed');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_tax_breakdown WHEN(SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is sealed');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_lineage_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN(NEW.draft_id IS NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas p WHERE p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND p.sealed=1)))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id))OR(NEW.draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_proforma_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.source_proforma_id AND c.resulting_draft_id=NEW.draft_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid invoice proforma lineage');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF id,draft_id,source_proforma_id,organization_id,fiscal_year,document_type,series,number,issue_date,due_date,issued_at,currency,issuer_legal_name,issuer_tax_identifier,issuer_country_code,issuer_city,issuer_street,issuer_county,issuer_postal_code,issuer_legal_form,issuer_trade_registry_number,issuer_iban,issuer_bank_name,issuer_social_capital,issuer_vat_registered,issuer_branding,customer_party_type,customer_legal_name,customer_tax_identifier,customer_country_code,customer_city,customer_street,customer_county,customer_postal_code,total_excluding_tax,tax_total,total_including_tax,notes ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable except e_factura_status');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoices are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_insert BEFORE INSERT ON issued_invoices WHEN NOT((NEW.source_app IS NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NULL)OR(NEW.source_app IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_kind IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_id IS NOT NULL AND length(NEW.source_app) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(NEW.source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid invoice source');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_source_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF source_app,source_kind,source_id ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice source is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoices_actor_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_id ON issued_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice actor is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_conversions_require_lineage BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_conversions WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proformas p WHERE p.id=NEW.proforma_id AND p.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND p.sealed=1)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_drafts d WHERE d.id=NEW.resulting_draft_id AND d.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND d.status='draft')OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_invoice_conversions i WHERE i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issued_invoices i WHERE i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.source_proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid proforma draft conversion lineage');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_invoice_conversions_match BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_invoice_conversions WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proforma_conversions c WHERE c.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND c.proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issued_invoices i WHERE i.id=NEW.resulting_invoice_id AND i.organization_id=NEW.organization_id AND i.draft_id IS NULL AND i.source_proforma_id=NEW.proforma_id)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma invoice conversion does not match');END
